core_obligations: Record that the scheme theoretic image Z is constructed in the indicated section (proof lines 8250-8252).
Show that h is quasi-compact and hence that |h|(|X|) is dense in |Z| (proof lines 8253-8256).
Show that |h|(|X|) is closed in |Y| so that X -> Z is surjective (proof lines 8257-8259).
Conclude that Z -> B is proper by the image-proper lemma (proof lines 8259-8260).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in a commutative triangle X -> Y -> B over S with X -> B proper and Y -> B separated and locally of finite type, the scheme theoretic image Z of X -> Y is proper over B and X -> Z is surjective (source lines 8231-8248). The proof observes that h : X -> Y is quasi-compact by the permanence lemma, so |h|(|X|) is dense in |Z|; on the other hand that image is closed in |Y| by the permanence statement for universally closed morphisms, so X -> Z is surjective; properness of Z -> B then follows from the image-proper lemma.
